content: Discussion for LeanBET (from #Project announcements > LeanBET )

Tyler Josephson ⚛️ said in #Project announcements > LeanBET:

polymorphic functions over Reals and Floats

Did you use type classes? I think it would be nice to make this somehow generally available. E.g. I wanted to give a definition of Brownian motion but also be able to sample paths in order e.g. price financial derivatives.

Dominic Steinitz said:

Tyler Josephson ⚛️ said in #Project announcements > LeanBET:

polymorphic functions over Reals and Floats

Did you use type classes? I think it would be nice to make this somehow generally available. E.g. I wanted to give a definition of Brownian motion but also be able to sample paths in order e.g. price financial derivatives.

Yes. In LeanLJ, we defined a type class subsuming Reals and Floats here (we called it RealLike). In LeanBET, we did that here, calling it BETLike. Each of these type classes were built with a single software application in mind (e.g., we added the round function if we needed it, added the sqrt function if we needed it). We actually do have a third one in development here, where our intention is to make it general-purpose - I'm actually about to start a separate conversation about this one.
Here's a broader discussion about the type class approach (which goes beyond this project): #general > Typeclasses for Reals + Floats
